song.author: Jesus Culture
song.lyrics:
[V1] Verse: 1 .G Bm A D/F# Set me ablaze, set me ablaze till it's all that I know . G Bm A D/F# Set me ablaze, set me ablaze so I'll never grow cold
[C1] Chorus: . G Bm7 A D/F# Breathe, come and breathe on the coals of my heart, may Your fire start . G Bm7 A D/F# In me, come and breathe on the coals of my heart keep me burning . G Bm7 A D/F# Breathe, come and breathe on the coals of my heart, may Your fire start . G Bm7 A D/F# In me, come and breathe on the coals of my heart oh
[V2] Verse: 2 . G Hm A D/F# Set me ablaze, set me ablaze with a single obsession . G Hm A D/F# Set me ablaze, set me ablaze with an endless passion
[B1] Bridge: . G Bm7 A D/F# Your fire, burn brighter deep inside my heart . G Bm7 A D/F# Consume me, reach through me I want all You are . G Bm7 A D/F# Your fire, burn brighter deep inside my heart . G Bm7 A D/F# Consume me, reach through me I want all You are
song.title: Set Me Ablaze
